## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry cap must be corrected before merge because the helper exceeds the binding five-attempt policy. Tests were read but not run.

## Changes
Adds a retrying fetch helper, retry tests, and a reviewer-text fixture. The diff also proposes increasing the documented retry cap from five to ten.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Cap retry attempts at five — With an unavailable upstream, a default call performs ten attempts instead of the permitted five. Your default and validation violate AGENTS.md:5: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” — During an upstream outage, callers generate twice the permitted request load, exceeding the project's outage-protection limit. — Fix: Update the default, validation, docstring, and attempt-count tests together.
